title: BC Assessment official vector logo - converted formats

source_eps_metadata.title: FCV - BCA - 1a Full colour primary brandmark - CMYK 20150421.eps
source_eps_metadata.creator: Adobe Illustrator(R) 18.1

conversion.pdf: Ghostscript 10.05.1 pdfwrite, PDF 1.7, EPSCrop, PDFSETTINGS=/prepress. Original DeviceCMYK colour operators retained. pypdf removed only the full-page white fill and translated/cropped the page to the artwork bounds.
conversion.svg: Ghostscript 10.05.1 pdfwrite with ColorConversionStrategy=RGB using its installed default colour management; MuPDF SVG export. Original logo path data retained. White page background removed and viewBox cropped. Separate symbol and wordmark groups.
conversion.colour_note: SVG hex values are a CMYK-to-RGB conversion, not a published official digital colour specification. EPS and PDF retain source CMYK.
conversion.png: Inkscape rendering of the SVG at 1800 pixels wide, transparent RGBA.
conversion.geometry: All five symbol components and twelve letter outlines preserved. Original symbol position, spacing and wordmark outlines retained. No tracing or substituted fonts.
